updates.title: CVE-2026-50481: Azure Active Directory Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A vulnerability in Azure Active Directory allows authorized attackers to elevate privileges by modifying assumed-immutable data, potentially compromising identity security and access controls across your tenant. Admins should apply the latest security updates immediately to prevent unauthorized privilege escalation.

updates.title: CVE-2026-59115: Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: A path traversal flaw in Microsoft Entra Provisioning Service (SyncFabric) enables authorized attackers to escalate privileges on the network. This affects identity synchronization and provisioning workflows, so admins should prioritize patching to maintain secure identity operations.

updates.title: CVE-2026-62869: Azure Entra ID Spoofing Vulnerability
updates.summary: Insufficient verification of data authenticity in Azure Entra ID allows authorized attackers to perform spoofing attacks over the network, potentially impersonating users or services. This threatens authentication integrity and should be patched urgently.

updates.title: CVE-2026-65668: Microsoft Purview eDiscovery Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
updates.summary: An improper access control flaw in Microsoft Purview eDiscovery allows authorized attackers to elevate their privileges, potentially exposing sensitive litigation hold and case data. Compliance and legal teams relying on eDiscovery should ensure systems are patched promptly.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot – Web Search Protection
updates.summary: Microsoft is expanding DLP controls to prevent sensitive data from being used in external web searches when users interact with Microsoft 365 Copilot and Copilot Chat. This real-time safeguard helps organizations prevent accidental data leakage through AI-powered features.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP – Non-Microsoft Connected Apps Support
updates.summary: DLP and auto-labeling capabilities now extend to third-party services including Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, AWS, and Cisco Webex, giving organizations unified data protection across their entire app ecosystem. This reduces shadow IT risks and enforcement gaps.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Endpoint DLP – Device Health Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: Admins now have visibility into device health across their fleet to ensure systems are ready for policy updates and to quickly identify devices that may not be compliant or operational. This improves endpoint DLP deployment reliability and troubleshooting.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Adaptive Scope – Recipient and Site Owner Lifecycle Status Control
updates.summary: Administrators can now explicitly control how lifecycle states (active, inactive, departed) are evaluated for recipients and site owners in Adaptive Scopes, ensuring retention and DLP policies target the right users as personnel changes occur. This improves governance accuracy during organizational transitions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP – Guided Diagnostics and Troubleshooting
updates.summary: A new diagnostic tool helps admins understand why DLP policies behave unexpectedly by displaying which policies triggered, evaluation order, and which conditions passed or failed. E5 customers also receive Copilot-powered insights and remediation recommendations.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Information Protection – Auto-Labeling Scale Increase
updates.summary: Auto-labeling capacity for SharePoint and OneDrive is increasing from 100,000 to 500,000 files per tenant per day, enabling faster classification of larger data estates and better preparation for Microsoft 365 Copilot deployments. This helps organizations close labeling gaps more quickly.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management – Archive SharePoint Files Under Retention
updates.summary: Retention policies can now include archiving actions for inactive SharePoint content, allowing files to move to low-cost storage while remaining discoverable for compliance purposes. This extends lifecycle management capabilities beyond keep-or-delete decisions.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP – SLA-Based Alert Reporting Dashboard
updates.summary: A new dashboard provides out-of-the-box metrics for mean time to acknowledge (MTTA), mean time to detect (MTTD), and mean time to resolve (MTTR) against customizable SLAs, helping security teams track operational performance and trending sensitive data exposures. This enables data-driven prioritization of alert response.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP – Rule-Based Alert Tagging and Auto-Resolution
updates.summary: Admins can now define rules to automatically tag and resolve predictable DLP alerts (e.g., resolve low-severity mail-only alerts, tag department-specific alerts), reducing triage burden and noise in alert queues. This improves SOC efficiency and focuses attention on genuine risks.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Information Protection – Sensitivity Labels for Entra Security Groups
updates.summary: Sensitivity labels can now be applied to Microsoft Entra cloud security groups using the same published labels configured for Microsoft 365 groups, extending classification and governance to identity-based resources without separate configuration. This unifies labeling policy across identity and collaboration surfaces.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP for Microsoft 365 Copilot – Government Cloud Support
updates.summary: DLP controls for Microsoft 365 Copilot are expanding to government cloud environments, allowing agencies to prevent sensitive data in prompts from being used for responses or grounding. This addresses compliance requirements in government tenants.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview DLP – Network Data Security Integration with Entra Global Secure Access
updates.summary: DLP now integrates with Microsoft Entra Global Secure Access to intercept and inspect text and AI interactions at the network layer, blocking sensitive data from reaching untrusted cloud applications across browsers, APIs, and generative AI platforms. This provides network-level data protection beyond traditional endpoint and cloud app controls.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management – Unified Alert Experience
updates.summary: Insider Risk Management now combines the Triage Agent and Standard alert dashboards into a single alerts list, allowing analysts to view classic and agent-triaged alerts together with agent summaries and user details in one location. This improves workflow efficiency for risk investigation and response.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Insider Risk Management – Expanded User Profile Details
updates.summary: The unified alert experience now displays additional Entra ID user profile signals including office location, employee type, department, and last working date, providing investigators with richer context for user risk assessment. This helps correlate insider risk signals with organizational changes and personnel status.

updates.title: Microsoft Purview Data Lifecycle Management – Graph API Support for Archive Mailboxes
updates.summary: Microsoft Graph API now provides access to Archive mailboxes (Main and Auxiliary combined), enabling a unified Archive view across multiple physical mailboxes as EWS Graph APIs sunset by October 2026. This simplifies mailbox archive management and policy application.
